## 🧪 Smoke Checklist & Verification

Please verify that you have tested your changes against the smoke checklist before requesting review:

- [ ] Dashboard loads and functions properly in Guest Mode (no Supabase account needed)
- [ ] Logged progress (counter `+`/`-`, time logs, prayer taps) persists after page reload
- [ ] Pomodoro timer runs, pauses, and resets without issues (if touched)
- [ ] Browser console is clean of unhandled JavaScript errors
- [ ] **Service Worker Notice**: If you added, deleted, or renamed any files, did you update `CACHE_NAME` in `sw.js` and `?v=` in `index.html`?
